spec: PLAN_V5_REPORT_PIPELINE.md §3 / §7 T9; Methodology formulas (1)–(5) (packages/reports/src/content.mjs FORMULAS, LAYERS_TEXT, MECH_TEXT); MODEL_REFERENCE.md §18, §19, §19.1, §19.2, §24.1, §24.2
inputs: inputs_v5/*.table.json (dump_inputs_v5.mjs), docs/backup/ascend-allocation/results.json (recommended plans: mechanisms, levers, k, binding), docs/backup/arch-mechanism-shapley/*.json

inputs.construction: applyMechanisms(base, mechanisms, REMAP_LATEST_PARAMS) → deratedOf → applyLevers(levers, DERATE_DEFAULT); then withHardwareFactors(k) on every class with failure.value > 0

cases.note: First-order closed form: kStar has φ and F frozen at k = 1; resultsK is the engine bisection root of A_op,der(k) = A* with φ evaluated at k (the defining "mean binds" k). φ moves with k through the silent-corruption window, so the two agree to ~1e-5 relative (decision of 2026-10-21): tolerances 2e-5 on k and 3e-7 on A_op(kStar) − A*.

identity: phi uses the engine A_op of the table at k
inputs.construction: applyMechanisms(base, mechanisms, REMAP_LATEST_PARAMS) → deratedOf → applyLevers(levers, DERATE_DEFAULT) → withHardwareFactors(resultsK)

cases.note: Identity at the engine's bisection root: formula (1) evaluated on the derated design at results.json's k reproduces A* to 1e-9; ΣC(k) = k·ΣC₁ shows that only the hardware pause scales; phiShiftFromK1 is the φ(k) − φ(1) that the first-order form of (a) neglects.
